## Compose a source-bound review result

For each material finding or completion claim, connect the requirement, exact target/source, observed behavior or check, its impact and the limit of the evidence. Distinguish current observations from reused checks, unsupported claims and missing evidence. Keep the existing compliance-first then quality review order and one existing verdict. Preserve read-only scope, finding IDs, severity, privacy and final verification ownership. A shorter report that loses a required check or promotes unknown to PASS is a defective variant.
